description: Weekly dependency PRs: each is reviewed and merged by hand, and merging to main deploys.

packageRules.description: Majors one at a time, only when asked for in the Dependency Dashboard issue
The API (api-server: Vercel, plus the watcher and revenue-share job on the Normies server): its minor and patch updates in one weekly PR
The indexer (on the Normies server; a merge deploys a new release): its minor and patch updates in one weekly PR
GitHub Actions in the CI workflows, together
Held: @types/node 24 for the API, the Node version Vercel builds it with
Held: @types/node 22 for the indexer, the Node version the Normies server runs

Overrides written as name@range, the security floors pnpm audit --fix adds, stay as written: Renovate misreads them (in ygtdmn/panorama it proposed brace-expansion 5 for a 2.x floor). Plain pins (name: version) still get updates. New advisories still show in Dependabot alerts and deps-check.
